title: The construction of Tb3+ doped Sr–BDC metal–organic framework materials and their high-sensitivity fluorescent detection of Fe3+
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,29720-29726
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA03729H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Huan Yang, Xin Chen, Yaling Yu, Changjin Liang, Yunying Wu, Boxin Qiu, Chenyang Zhang, Shaomin Lin
A Tb3+-functionalized Sr–BDC MOF synthesized solvothermally, emits bright green light (λem = 545 nm) and selectively detects Fe3+ (LOD 7.3 μM, 5–100 μM), serving as a reliable probe for environmental and biomedical monitoring.
